figures.caption: Figure 1. All sequence modeling layers can be expressed as a hidden state that transitions according to an update rule. Our key idea is to make the hidden state itself a model f with weights W , and the update rule a gradient step on the self-supervised loss ℓ. Therefore, updating the hidden state on a test sequence is equivalent to training the model f at test time. This process, known as Test-Time Training (TTT), is programmed into our TTT layers.
